instruction: A cinematic video still, medium shot, captures a joyful dance in an indoor studio with a soft pink and blue gradient background. On the left, the Black woman with braided hair in a pink fringed dress (R1) is shown in profile facing right, smiling as she dances with a raised fist. On the right, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) faces her, laughing and looking at her partner with her hand raised. They dance facing each other in a lively, shared moment. The scene is bathed in soft, colorful studio lighting with warm pink and blue hues.

R3 faces R1 while laughing and raising her hand
